name: M3_PMS100MI_UpdOperation
description: Update operation details for an existing manufacturing order. Use this to maintain information such as work center, operation description, setup and run times, labor and machine capacity, costing parameters, scrap settings, automation flags, and operation-related texts. The update applies to a single operation within a manufacturing order and assumes that the order and its operations are already created and released in line with your production process.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order operation to update is registered.

inputParameters.name: PRNO
inputParameters.description: Product number for the item on the manufacturing order that contains the operation to update.

inputParameters.name: MFNO
inputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number identifying the order whose operation is updated.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for the manufacturing order whose operation is updated.

inputParameters.name: OPNO
inputParameters.description: Operation number within the manufacturing order for selecting or updating a specific operation.

inputParameters.name: PLGR
inputParameters.description: Work center where the operation is performed.

inputParameters.name: OPDS
inputParameters.description: Short description of the operation.

inputParameters.name: DEPT
inputParameters.description: Department to which the operation's work center belongs.

inputParameters.name: REAR
inputParameters.description: Planning area to which the operation's work center belongs.

inputParameters.name: PITI
inputParameters.description: Run time per price/time quantity used when planning the operation.

inputParameters.name: CTCD
inputParameters.description: Quantity basis used for the operation's unit price and run time.

inputParameters.name: SETI
inputParameters.description: Setup time to apply for the operation, replacing the current setup time when the update is executed.

inputParameters.name: OSET
inputParameters.description: External setup time that can be performed while the machine is running for this operation.

inputParameters.name: FXTI
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the operation's run time is fixed regardless of quantity.

inputParameters.name: PRNM
inputParameters.description: Planned number of machines used for the operation.

inputParameters.name: PRNP
inputParameters.description: Planned number of workers used during the operation's run time.

inputParameters.name: SENP
inputParameters.description: Planned number of workers used for operation setup.

inputParameters.name: PRDY
inputParameters.description: Number of days the operation is planned to be in progress between its start and finish dates.

inputParameters.name: AUIN
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether automatic receipt is triggered when the last operation in the order is reported.

inputParameters.name: AURP
inputParameters.description: Controls whether and how this operation is reported automatically based on reported quantities.

inputParameters.name: SCPC
inputParameters.description: Normal scrap percentage defined for the item in this operation.

inputParameters.name: WLDE
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether finite capacity planning is used when scheduling this operation.

inputParameters.name: DOID
inputParameters.description: Document ID linked to the operation for related documentation.

inputParameters.name: TOOL
inputParameters.description: Tool number required to perform the operation.

inputParameters.name: PLLT
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the work center controls how lot numbers are created for this operation.

inputParameters.name: CRTR
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the operation uses a critical resource that needs special monitoring.

inputParameters.name: LASK
inputParameters.description: Labor skill code required to perform the operation.

inputParameters.name: SWQT
inputParameters.description: Extra material quantity consumed as setup scrap for this operation.

inputParameters.name: CAMP
inputParameters.description: Number of labor tickets to be printed for this operation.

inputParameters.name: PIPR
inputParameters.description: Unit price used for costing and payroll for work performed in this operation.

inputParameters.name: WAFA
inputParameters.description: Time rate used together with the unit price when calculating the operation cost.

inputParameters.name: SEPR
inputParameters.description: Cost for the setup activities required before this operation can begin.

inputParameters.name: WCRF
inputParameters.description: Time reference code used to group this operation for scheduling.

inputParameters.name: KIWG
inputParameters.description: Pay element describing the wage type to apply to this operation, such as setup work or overtime.

inputParameters.name: INWE
inputParameters.description: Weight of the material in kilos before this operation is performed.

inputParameters.name: OPV3
inputParameters.description: Operation volume used as a cost driver in product costing.

inputParameters.name: MFPR
inputParameters.description: Multiplication factor used in manufacturing costing to neutralize unit differences for this operation.

inputParameters.name: OPCM
inputParameters.description: Multiplier used to adjust this operation's cost in product costing.

inputParameters.name: TXT1
inputParameters.description: Free text line 1 for additional information about the operation.

inputParameters.name: TXT2
inputParameters.description: Free text line 2 for additional information about the operation.

inputParameters.name: PLG6
inputParameters.description: Work center resource within the work center that performs this operation.

inputParameters.name: APON
inputParameters.description: Primary operation number used by advanced planning to group this operation with parallel operations.

inputParameters.name: NXOP
inputParameters.description: Number of the next operation in the routing sequence after this operation.

inputParameters.name: SLAT
inputParameters.description: Code defining how this operation overlaps or queues to the next operation.

inputParameters.name: SLAC
inputParameters.description: Overlap base value used together with the overlap code when scheduling to the next operation.

inputParameters.name: POOC
inputParameters.description: Code controlling how this operation overlaps with its primary operation in scheduling.

inputParameters.name: RESR
inputParameters.description: Resource restriction value limiting which resources in the work center can perform this operation.

inputParameters.name: PLGF
inputParameters.description: Resource that is fixed for use by this operation when it is scheduled.

inputParameters.name: PRET
inputParameters.description: Preparation time inserted between this operation and the next as part of inter-operation time.

inputParameters.name: POTM
inputParameters.description: Post-operation time inserted between the end of this operation and the start of the next.

inputParameters.name: SPLK
inputParameters.description: Method used to split this operation across multiple machines or parallel operations.

inputParameters.name: SPLF
inputParameters.description: Fixed rate amount that can be split into several partial invoices for this operation.

inputParameters.name: SPLN
inputParameters.description: Number of operations created when this operation is split according to the split method.

inputParameters.name: SPSZ
inputParameters.description: Quantity per split operation when splitting this operation by quantity.

inputParameters.name: ODBF
inputParameters.description: Lead time offset in workdays between the start of this operation and the product finish date, calculated by the system.
